question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
WITH customer_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_customers FROM customer
),
rental_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) as customers_with_top_5_actors
    FROM rental r
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
    WHERE fa.actor_id IN (107, 102, 198, 181, 23)
)
SELECT 
    cc.total_customers,
    rc.customers_with_top_5_actors,
    ROUND(100.0 * rc.customers_with_top_5_actors / cc.total_customers, 2) as percentage
FROM customer_counts cc, rental_counts rc
